info.name: Bazario API (marketplace, RBAC)
info.description:
Seller commission: each seller pays a percentage of sales (5% standard, 3% preferred). Run in order: 01 Auth > 02 Roles > 03 Users > 04 Products > 05 Orders > 06 Categories > 07 Seller Hub > 08 Festival offers > 09 Admin > 10 Permission checks.
Collection variables hold tokens and ids; the test scripts fill them in automatically.

request.description: Public. Expect {"status":"UP"}.
Run this FIRST. Saves the admin JWT into the collection variable `token`.
201 on first run, 409 if the email already exists (then use 'Login as customer').
Self-registration as a seller needs a store name. 409 if the email exists (then use 'Login as seller').
Any logged-in user. Shows roles and effective permissions.
Needs ROLES_READ.
Needs ROLES_READ.
Needs ROLES_CREATE. Name must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. You can only grant permissions you hold.
Needs ROLES_READ.
Needs ROLES_UPDATE. ADMIN cannot be modified; built-in roles cannot be renamed.
Needs ROLES_DELETE. 409 while the role is still assigned to a user (unassign first) or if built-in.
Needs USERS_READ. Register the customer first.
Needs USERS_READ.
Needs USERS_UPDATE. Replaces the user's roles. Effective immediately, no re-login. Create a role first (folder 02).
Needs USERS_UPDATE. The last ADMIN can never be demoted (409).
Needs USERS_DELETE. 409 if the user has orders, is yourself, or is the last ADMIN.
Needs PRODUCTS_CREATE.
Needs PRODUCTS_UPDATE.
Needs PRODUCTS_DELETE.
Any logged-in user. Run 'Create product' first so {{productId}} is valid. 409 = not enough stock.
Own orders only.
Needs ORDERS_READ_ALL.
Needs ORDERS_UPDATE. Statuses: PLACED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED.
Cancelling puts the stock back. A cancelled order cannot be reopened (409).
Needs ORDERS_DELETE.

item.name: 06 Categories
item.description: Public to read; only users with CATEGORIES_MANAGE (admin) can change them.

request.description: Needs CATEGORIES_MANAGE.
Needs CATEGORIES_MANAGE.
Category filtering, like Flipkart / Amazon. Also supports q= and sellerId=.
409 while products still use it.

item.name: 07 Seller Hub
item.description: Everything a seller does. Log in as seller first (01 Auth).

request.description: Needs PRODUCTS_CREATE.
The product is owned by the caller. Run 06 > Create category first (or remove categoryId).
Sellers can only change their own products (403 otherwise). Admin with PRODUCTS_MANAGE_ALL can change any.
A buyer (no seller permissions) is refused. Use a second seller token to see the ownership rule.

item.name: Place order for the seller's product (as customer)

request.description: Buyers pay the offer price. Sellers cannot buy their own products (409).
Needs SELLER_ORDERS_READ. Only lines for this seller's products; buyer email is masked.
Needs SELLER_ORDERS_READ. grossSales, commission (kept by Bazario), netEarnings, payable (delivered) and pending.
Needs SELLER_ORDERS_UPDATE and ownership of the line.

item.name: 08 Festival offers (seller controlled)
item.description: Sellers decide festival sales for their own products only.

request.description: Needs OFFERS_MANAGE. Choose festival, discount (1-90), dates and products (or appliesToAll). Run 07 > Create product first.

item.name: Product now shows the sale price (public)

exec: pm.test("finalPrice is lower than price", function () { var p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.finalPrice).to.be.below(p.price); });

request.description: price = list price, finalPrice = what the buyer pays, discountPercent and offerName describe the sale.
Sellers see their own offers; admin (OFFERS_MANAGE_ALL) sees all.
Needs STATS_READ.
OFFERS_MANAGE_ALL sees every seller's offers.
Needs COMMISSION_MANAGE. Every seller with their rate, units sold, gross sales and the commission earned. Register the seller first (01 Auth).
